items.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: So that's why you see him and I, sometimes you see one of us down, one up. We understand. We understand this way. And we never let one another get out of step.

ctx.x: No. Because it's inside him. You see, I don't want against him. Against him. Nobody. If I get back up. You understand? That's the. But now, if a guy want to come in and see what he can do. This thing, you know. Well, I'm going to try and do it. You see, when he, A party get in the party now. I'm going to take my whole line. I'm going to see what he's going to do. But if a person comes out. You understand? Be nice. But I'm sure. Again. My band. I'm going to let my band fall. For. Trying to take a. Revenge. Or.…

You see, like him and I, we're about the only two that I know of. Wait together. You see, now, like sometimes you might see me look over at him. Well, that means that I'm going down, you see. If I throw my horn up, he know I'm going to pick up. And if I lay my horn down like this, he know that I'm going to pull down. If he do the same thing, I know he's going to take down, you see. And if he put his horn up, I know he's going to go up. So that's why you see him and I, sometimes you see one of us down, one up. We…
I'll give him that all the time. All the only this last time. All the last time he messed me up. One time I thought that.
